import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {
    "m": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main",
    "r": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships",
}

def col_to_idx(ref):
    letters = re.match(r"[A-Z]+", ref).group()
    idx = 0
    for ch in letters:
        idx = idx * 26 + (ord(ch) - ord("A") + 1)
    return idx - 1

with zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx") as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    print("ARCHIVE CONTENTS:")
    for n in names:
        print(" ", n)
    print()

    # shared strings
    shared = []
    if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in names:
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
        for si in root.findall("m:si", NS):
            text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t"))
            shared.append(text)

    # workbook sheet list
    wb_root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    sheets = [(s.get("name"), s.get("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id"))
              for s in wb_root.find("m:sheets", NS)]

    # map rel id -> target
    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
    relmap = {r.get("Id"): r.get("Target") for r in rels}

    for sheet_name, rid in sheets:
        target = relmap[rid]
        if not target.startswith("xl/"):
            target = "xl/" + target.lstrip("/")
        xml_path = target
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(xml_path))
        print(f"=== Sheet: {sheet_name} ({xml_path}) ===")
        rows = {}
        for c in root.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}c"):
            ref = c.get("r")
            t = c.get("t")
            v = c.find("m:v", NS)
            if v is None:
                val = None
            elif t == "s":
                val = shared[int(v.text)]
            elif t == "inlineStr":
                is_el = c.find("m:is", NS)
                val = "".join(x.text or "" for x in is_el.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t"))
            elif t == "b":
                val = v.text == "1"
            elif t == "str":
                val = v.text
            else:
                val = v.text
            m = re.match(r"([A-Z]+)(\d+)", ref)
            col, row = m.group(1), int(m.group(2))
            rows.setdefault(row, {})[col] = val
        max_row = max(rows) if rows else 0
        all_cols = sorted({c for r in rows.values() for c in r})
        header = ["Row"] + all_cols
        print(" | ".join(header))
        for r in range(1, max_row + 1):
            print(" | ".join([str(r)] + [str(rows.get(r, {}).get(c, "")) for c in all_cols]))
        print()
